newsitem.title: USA: Legato, HighGround in marketing agreement.
newsitem.headline: Legato, HighGround in marketing agreement.

text.p: Legato Systems Inc said Monday it had joined HighGround Systems Inc in a technology-sharing and marketing agreement to integrate Legato's Networker with Windows NT Changer Media Services and HighGround's NTMS Pro extensions.
Also, Legato will resell HighGround's SRM applications and work to interface Legato's GEMS (Global Enterprise Management of Storage) with NTMS.
The expected result would be to improve reliability and availability of removable storage resources in Windows NT environments.
Legato makes network storage management products for heterogeneous client/server computing environments. Its shares were down 3/4 to 16-3/4 Monday afternoon.
HighGround, a privately held company based in Boxborough, Mass., makes storage resource management tools.
